# Love begins with taste

Five meat products from Kazan with disclosed ingredients, no sodium nitrite and nutrition you can read before you buy.

All five products are covered by Halal certificate No. 614A/2024 issued by the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of the Republic of Tatarstan.

## Five products. No ingredient-list shortcuts.

Calculated estimate per 100 g of raw recipe; not a laboratory value.

- [Chicken fillet ham](https://yaratu.com/en/products/vetchina/): Mild chicken ham with a fully disclosed ingredient list. 125 kcal, 16.7 g protein.
- [Mramornaya cooked smoked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/mramornaya/): Chicken and beef sausage with a savoury spiced profile. 264 kcal, 14.9 g protein.
- [Sausages with broccoli](https://yaratu.com/en/products/brokkoli/): Chicken and beef sausages with broccoli and gentle spices. 230 kcal, 13 g protein.
- [Molochnye milk sausages](https://yaratu.com/en/products/molochnye/): A mild classic profile with compound ingredients fully disclosed. 239 kcal, 13.5 g protein.
- [Slivochnaya cooked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/slivochnaya/): A gentle creamy profile with a fully disclosed ingredient list. 174 kcal, 14.4 g protein.
